messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

These results do not describe how much Mounjaro lowers risk compared with no treatment.

The relation 'compared with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is evaluated or analyzed in relation to the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'tested in': The subject drug was evaluated in the clinical trial specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
